messages:
maria: Opened PR for on-prem install guide updates (https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/578). Need: MTU warning, small PKCS#11 appendix note, and a tiny preflight curl.

jon: I can update the network diagram to show dual-homed HSMs and NAT path. Will label PMTU warning.

samira: Please add explicit instruction: HSM subnets must not have public egress. Also add recommended MSS tweak for site-to-site VPNs.

kevin: Adding a 2-line curl conn-check to the PR now and a compact Python snippet using RW_KMS_TOKEN.

link-bot: Linkcheck: broken anchor -> offline-install#checksum. Suggested fix: add id="checksum" to header and update TOC to /offline-install/#checksum.

maria: I'll patch the header id and merge after link-bot green. Fast-track approved if green.

jon: SVG uploaded to assets/private-onprem-v1.svg.

kevin: Snippets added. One-liner in appendix points to PKCS#11 for air-gapped flow.

maria: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" — will squash+merge once link-bot clears.
